verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). This is backed by a documented REST API reference that is OpenAI-compatible and a parallel gRPC API reference. Missing for 10: first-party docs that point users to the spec download, evidence of the spec's coverage and completeness (e.g., whether it spans inference and management endpoints), and independent corroboration of its use.
